message: So, the other day I finally decided to tackle our smoke alarms – you know, the ones that were probably installed during the last century. 😅 I tested them all and even made a little escape plan with the kids. It felt great to finally be the prepared one for once! Now, instead of just hoping for the best, I know we have a plan in place. It’s funny how a little effort can turn into peace of mind, right? What’s one small thing you've done lately to feel more prepared?
